tab.intro: Control the mouse cursor with head movements. Useful for menu navigation and in-game UI interaction without reaching for a controller.
tab.defaultSummary: Applies to applications without a custom profile. Tune sensitivity and deadzone to your preference.
tab.enabledHint: Head Cursor applies to applications without a custom profile.
tab.disabledHint: Head Cursor stays off unless an enabled custom profile turns it on.
tab.broadEnablementBody: Head Cursor applies to applications without a custom profile, including ones you have not validated. The safer setup is Default Off with this list used as an application allowlist.
tab.emptyProfiles: No custom profiles yet. Add one when an application needs different Head Cursor settings from the default.

binding.label: Toggle Binding
binding.description: Press the assigned control to temporarily disable Head Cursor. Press again to re-enable.
binding.noneText: No binding assigned. Head Cursor stays active unless you assign a toggle control.

inverted.label: Inverted toggle
inverted.onHint: Binding enables Head Cursor (disabled by default, press to activate).
inverted.offHint: Binding disables Head Cursor (enabled by default, press to suspend).

fields.yawSensitivityHint: How quickly horizontal head movement translates to cursor speed.
fields.pitchSensitivityHint: How quickly vertical head movement translates to cursor speed.
fields.yawMultiplierHint: Scale factor for horizontal cursor displacement.
fields.pitchMultiplierHint: Scale factor for vertical cursor displacement.
fields.deadzoneHint: Minimum head movement before cursor starts moving. Higher values reduce jitter.
fields.maxMovePerFrameHint: Maximum cursor displacement per frame to prevent overshooting.
